reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug in this channel. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

While the kiosks were down, the guard wrote trailer numbers on a clipboard. At 11:03 AM Mateo said kiosk 1 was back, and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07 AM. So the outage ran about 25 minutes by your report.

Mateo also reported six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44.
